hero_title: Nomads sharing their desert with the world
intro_title: From the last village before the great Sahara
intro_description:
Walk The Sahara was born in M'Hamid El Ghizlane, a small village at the end of the road in southern Morocco. Beyond M'Hamid there is only desert \u2014 60 kilometers of open Sahara to the great dunes of Erg Chigaga.

For generations our family has walked this desert with camels, crossing the hamada and the dunes to reach grazing land, water, and other nomad families. The desert is not a place we visit \u2014 it is our home.

We started Walk The Sahara to share this home with travelers who want more than a photo stop. We walk at the pace of the camels. We cook on the fire. We sleep under the stars. And we invite you to do the same.

values.title: Authenticity
values.text: We share the desert exactly as we have always lived in it. No staged shows, no tourist performances.

values.title: ustainability
values.text: We use local supplies, local crews, and leave no trace. Every tour supports our community directly.

values.title: Quality
values.text: Small groups, hand-built camps, real food. We do fewer tours and we do them well.

values.title: Respect
values.text: We respect the desert, our guests, and our nomad culture. We ask the same in return.
